findings.summary: At 3 HP, the scorer preferred slower Rock Throw over Ice Shard even though both guaranteed the KO, exposing Lildozer to a needless reply.

resolution.observed: Scorer v11 selected Ice Shard from the same live RAM state; it acted first and KOed Whirlipede.

findings.observed_fact: Canonical state dce374911b14528b verified Rock Throw at 10-12 damage acting second and Ice Shard at 4-5 damage acting first against 3 HP.
findings.strategic_judgment: Guaranteed KOs before a reply must outrank higher-damage guaranteed KOs that act second.
findings.next_test: Keep the priority-finisher regression green; add exact Rocky Helmet and chained Rollout mechanics before a future narrow-margin recommendation depends on them.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The live state advanced after the corrected action; the exact pre-state and both certificates remain in battle_transactions.jsonl and the focused regression reproduces it.

findings.summary: The ranking exposed Rocky Helmet recoil and multi-turn Rollout escalation only as unmodeled gaps, so total survival cost was incomplete.
findings.observed_fact: Aerial Ace caused Rocky Helmet recoil and Whirlipede then used Rollout; Birdlaw fell from 25 to 10 HP.
findings.strategic_judgment: Add exact contact recoil and chained-move state before relying on narrow survival margins in future recommendations.
findings.next_test: Keep the priority-finisher regression green; add exact Rocky Helmet and chained Rollout mechanics before a future narrow-margin recommendation depends on them.

findings.summary: Two Whirlipede replies were incompletely recorded: the missed Rollout had no PP delta and a later 3 HP hit had no enemy move ID.
findings.observed_fact: Verified RAM HP changed while the corresponding transaction omitted an enemy move identity or PP delta.
findings.strategic_judgment: History reconstruction should retain chosen moves even on misses and identify damage replies before those records drive chained-move policy.
findings.next_test: Keep the priority-finisher regression green; add exact Rocky Helmet and chained Rollout mechanics before a future narrow-margin recommendation depends on them.

findings.summary: Razor Leaf critically KOed Frillish from 46 HP; the normal modeled range was only 32-42, so this win must not teach a guaranteed one-hit line.
findings.observed_fact: Battle text verified a critical hit and immediate Frillish faint.
findings.strategic_judgment: Retain the normal damage bounds and treat the one-turn KO as favorable variance.
findings.next_test: Keep the priority-finisher regression green; add exact Rocky Helmet and chained Rollout mechanics before a future narrow-margin recommendation depends on them.

correct_choices: Fresh-entry Fake Out was correctly rejected against Mareanie because Baneful Bunker had higher priority; Spark adapted after Soak and finished safely.
Bushtank survived Hex and removed Frillish without a faint; the critical KO was correctly classified as variance, not guaranteed strategy.
Birdlaw supplied Intimidate and 20 damage, then the scorer preserved it by pivoting to full-health Lildozer as Speed Boost and Rollout became dangerous.
The live 3 HP finisher defect was fixed in the shared scorer and verified immediately: Ice Shard KOed before any reply.
